chapter_outline.instruction: Create a chapter outline that follows the supplied template. Use supplied source IDs only.

generate_hook.instruction: Create one concise hook and explain the mechanism without unsupported claims.

expand_paragraph.instruction: Expand the paragraph while preserving its claim and only citing supplied IDs.

polish_paragraph.instruction: Polish clarity and rhythm without changing factual meaning.

compress_paragraph.instruction: Compress the paragraph while retaining necessary meaning and supplied citations.

rewrite_paragraph.instruction: Rewrite for the supplied constraints; do not invent facts or citations.

check_logic_gaps.instruction: Identify logic gaps only; do not produce an adoption candidate.

check_repetition.instruction: Identify repetition and filler only; do not produce an adoption candidate.

check_missing_sources.instruction: Identify unsupported claims using supplied evidence IDs only.

analyze_rhythm.instruction: Identify pacing and retention risks only; do not produce an adoption candidate.

overall_revision.instruction: Provide revision findings only; do not produce an adoption candidate.

visual_ideas.instruction: Propose visuals and asset requirements without claiming assets exist.

asset_list.instruction: Propose production asset requirements without automatically creating records.

estimate_duration.instruction: Estimate spoken or displayed duration in seconds.

packaging_concepts.instruction: Return exactly five title and thumbnail concepts. Do not select a final concept.
